item.mng: qutuγ-tu maṇǰušrii-yin teyin büged qubilγaqui bülüg neretü yeke kölgen sudur
item.coloph: enedkeg-ün ubadini sila indr-a bodhi kiged ǰina mitr-a ba yeke tokiyalduγuluγči kelemürči bande yeses sde orčiγuluγad nayiruγulǰu sin-e ǰasaγlaγsan kelen-iyer ǰasaǰu orosiγulbai, dai erketü kümün-ü eǰen delekei-tekin-ü qormusda-yin ǰarliγ-iyar samdan sengge mongγol-un kelen-dür orčiγuluγad nayiruγulǰu orosiγulbai, čakravarti qutuγ-tu dayiming lindan qaγan-u ǰarliγ-iyar čooski odser samdan darqan blam-a yi toltoyidču mayidari günding güsi orosiγulbai,
